manifest.procedure: Exact full-regime replay of frozen cal decisions; no tuning or selection
manifest.coverage_correction: Initial training/evaluation diagnostic was date-local. This replay includes <=5.1minute cross-midnight pairs when adjacent dates belong to the same regime.

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

campaign_gate.unit: paired calendar date; pooled macro recomputed inside every draw
campaign_gate.scope: Campaign primary fixed by original seals; stratified by season. Historical per-case gate_pass fields were only screens.

runtime.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
runtime.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk trafficflow/**/*.py at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present
